title: Prompt Engineering

category.name: Artificial Intelligence
category.description: Understand, build and use AI: machine learning, language models and responsible AI.

short_description: Get reliable, useful results from AI assistants such as Claude, and use them from your own code.
description: The same AI model can give a vague answer or an excellent one depending on how you ask. This course teaches the habits that work: clear instructions and context, examples, structure, asking for a specific output format, breaking big tasks into steps, and testing prompts. The last lesson shows how to call Claude from a Python program.

chapters.title: Prompts in Code
chapters.description: Use a model from your own program.
